title: Ingredient row
description: One row of ingredients.csv in a dataset folder. Each column is one key; an empty cell means the value is not reported.

aliases.description: Other names and spellings, separated by '|'. Leave empty for none.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: ID of an entry in a sources.yaml.

source_record.title: Source Record
source_record.description: Record ID in the source, such as a USDA FDC ID or a CoFID food code.

kcal.description: Energy in kcal per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

protein_g.description: Protein in g per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

fat_g.description: Total fat in g per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

sat_fat_g.description: Saturated fat in g per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

carbs_available_g.description: Available carbohydrate in g per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

sugars_g.description: Total sugars in g per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

fibre_g.description: Fibre in g per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

sodium_mg.description: Sodium in mg per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

iron_mg.description: Iron in mg per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

calcium_mg.description: Calcium in mg per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

zinc_mg.description: Zinc in mg per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

folate_ug.description: Folate in µg per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

vit_a_ug.description: Vitamin A in µg per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

vit_b12_ug.description: Vitamin B12 in µg per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

vit_c_mg.description: Vitamin C in mg per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

vit_d_ug.description: Vitamin D in µg per 100 g. Leave empty when the source does not report it; empty is not the same as 0.

gi_ref.title: Gi Ref
gi_ref.description: Where the GI came from: a source ID from a sources.yaml, a colon, then the source's food name, table and row, as in 'gi_compendium_2021: Idli (Table 1, T1-698)'. Needs gi.
